'''Sturdy leather boots''' are the [[Sturdy leather armor|sturdy leather]] [[Armor#Boots|boots]], crafted from 4 [[sturdy leather]]. Sturdy leather armor is a light set built against arrows and falls.

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}

=== Chest loot ===
{{Sources}}
The boots found in [[village]] tannery chests are an older version of the item. In 1.12.2 they are invisible when worn: their equipment asset is <code>minecraft:sturdy_leather</code>, but the resource pack defines the texture as <code>matcha:sturdy_leather</code>. They also give 1 block of safe fall distance instead of 2 and no extra step height, have Feather Falling III instead of II and one extra random enchantment, and are repaired with sturdy leather instead of tattered leather.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/equipment/sturdy_leather.json}}</ref> See [[Sturdy leather armor#Village tannery chests]].

== Usage ==

=== Armor ===
They give {{Value|Sturdy Leather Boots|armor}} armor with {{Value|Sturdy Leather Boots|durability}} durability and 2 blocks of safe fall distance, twice what leather gives. Projectile Protection II comes on the item as an ordinary enchantment. They also have Feather Falling II, the [[Trailblaze]] intrinsic, and 1 extra block of step height, which lets the wearer walk up full blocks without jumping.

=== Repairing ===
They can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[tattered leather]]. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so they can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].
